pr_body:
Additional renames done in encoder and decoder implementation
to follow the style.

Fixes #13622

Although in the OTC discussion it was preferred to split out the new and setup for phases into separate functions in the end I've decided not to do it as it is really convenient for the applications to have it like this. I do not see a point in having to always call two functions instead of one and it also conveniently avoids reusing the ctx for multiple encode/decode calls which we might not want to allow anyway.

issue_context.title: OSSL_DECODER_CTX_new_by_EVP_PKEY OSSL_ENCODED_CTX_new_by_EVP_PKEY
issue_context.body:
These API names aren't following the consistent pattern. 
Using _new_by is not the right approach. We have _new_from when constructing something.
e.g. EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_pkey

The APIs should be renamed to following that pattern.

And yes there is another use of new_by in EC_KEY_new_by_curve_name but that isn't the same sort of thing.

In English usage terms all the new_by should be new_from IMHO - but certainly the newly added APIs should be following the main naming convention already in use.
comments:
For starters, I agree that "by" wasn't the best choice.

Function like `EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_pkey` have "from" in them because they do something (create something new) from existing data (some input parameter, like a pkey), and while one could arguably have `OSSL_ENCODER_CTX_new_from_pkey`, the same kind of thinking doesn't quite fit for decoder variant, since it doesn't create the DECODER_CTX from existing pkey data.
The name choices for these two functions was made to strongly associate with the *type* of the intended input / output. I could imaging changing "by" to "for" in that mindset.
Should the names be OSSL_DECODER_CTX_new_for_pkey and OSSL_ENCODER_CTX_new_from_pkey then?
OTC: If we keep combined function then use _for_; but prefer to move into two functions then use _setup_for_ for the new function.

review_comments: This looks weird.  You have uppercased `type` to `TYPE` in some places, but not others.  Quite frankly, I don't see a reason for uppercasing that one at all, and would suggest simply undoing it.  It's a distraction for reviewing.
Please note that we need both type and TYPE because the TYPE is EVP_PKEY and type is just pkey here. Maybe the lowercase type should be renamed somehow, I welcome suggestions on how.
Ahhhhhh, I totally missed that point.  Ok, sure, this is fine with that in mind.
